name: npm Install Hook Spawns Node Loader (Supply Chain)
description: Detects an npm lifecycle hook spawning node to execute index.js/setup.js during install — the mini Shai-Hulud entry vector.
query: process where event.type == "start" and process.name == "node" and process.parent.name in ("npm", "node") and process.args : ("*index.js", "*setup.js") and process.parent.command_line : ("*install*", "*preinstall*", "*postinstall*", "* ci*")
author: sectest-builder

name: Node Spawns Curl/Unzip to Stage Bun Runtime
description: Detects node/npm/bun spawning curl/wget/unzip to download and extract the Bun runtime (ingress tool transfer).
query: process where event.type == "start" and process.name in ("curl", "wget", "unzip", "tar") and process.parent.name in ("node", "npm", "bun") and process.command_line : ("*oven-sh/bun*", "*bun-linux*", "*bun-darwin*", "*/tmp/b-*")
author: sectest-builder

name: Broad Credential File Sweep by Node Process
description: Detects a single node/bun process reading three or more high-value credential files in a short window (credential harvesting). Excludes F0RT1KA decoy tree.
query: sequence by process.entity_id with maxspan=2m [file where event.action in ("open", "read") and process.name in ("node", "bun") and file.path : ("*/.aws/credentials", "*/.ssh/id_rsa", "*/.ssh/id_ed25519", "*/.npmrc", "*/.git-credentials", "*/.kube/config", "*/.docker/config.json") and not file.path : "*shaihulud_decoys*"] [file where event.action in ("open", "read") and process.name in ("node", "bun") and file.path : ("*/.aws/credentials", "*/.ssh/id_rsa", "*/.ssh/id_ed25519", "*/.npmrc", "*/.git-credentials", "*/.kube/config", "*/.docker/config.json") and not file.path : "*shaihulud_decoys*"] [file where event.action in ("open", "read") and process.name in ("node", "bun") and not file.path : "*shaihulud_decoys*"]
author: sectest-builder

name: gh auth token Invoked by Node/Bun
description: Detects 'gh auth token' executed by a node/bun/shell process to steal the live GitHub CLI session token.
query: process where event.type == "start" and process.command_line : "*gh auth token*" and process.parent.name in ("node", "bun", "sh", "bash")
author: sectest-builder

name: Cloud Instance Metadata Access by Node/Bun
description: Detects node/bun/curl contacting the cloud instance metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 (cloud credential theft).
query: network where event.type == "start" and process.name in ("node", "bun", "curl") and destination.ip == "169.254.169.254"
author: sectest-builder

name: Worm Workflow Injection by Node/Bun
description: Detects node/bun writing to GitHub Actions workflow/loader files (.github/workflows/codeql.yml, .github/setup.js) — worm self-propagation.
query: file where event.type in ("creation", "change") and process.name in ("node", "bun") and file.path : ("*/.github/workflows/codeql.yml", "*/.github/setup.js")
author: sectest-builder

name: Anti-Forensic /tmp/p<random>.js Write-Then-Delete
description: Detects node/bun creating and quickly deleting a /tmp/p<digits>.js file (decrypted payload anti-forensic pattern).
query: sequence by process.entity_id with maxspan=1m [file where event.action == "creation" and process.name in ("node", "bun") and file.path regex~ "/tmp/p[0-9]+\.js"] [file where event.action == "deletion" and process.name in ("node", "bun") and file.path regex~ "/tmp/p[0-9]+\.js"]
author: sectest-builder
